name: deno
description: The retained updater body supports a primary self-update path, but integrity behavior depends on the path: full archive verification is conditional on a supplied checksum, whereas delta updates perform downloaded same-channel SHA-256 comparisons. No signing-key verification appears in the inspected updater body.
limitations: Newly retrieved snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release verification.
The inspected body does not establish how an operator controls release-host content or whether all callers supply upgrade_flags.checksum.
TLS/client behavior is outside these updater functions.
